The canonical high actions consequently inherit the actual analytic gap-square and normalized ratio, EXACT factorization I_n=G_n/(8*pi*n)*R_n, nonzero ratio, complex high zero-action IFF gap-square zero, and error norm(8*pi*n*I_n-G_n)<=norm(G_n)*epsilon on one complex neighborhood before all high indices. At EVERY COMPLEX point of this domain and EVERY epsilon>0, the already-proved complex high estimates give ONE open neighborhood and cutoff before ALL high indices, and the certified comparison transfers them to the canonical family.
